title: Founding Member
description: 🚀 Co-built and deployed a university resource platform (mmmut.xyz) for 1,000+ active students.
📚 Curated and organized 500+ verified academic resources for students.
💻 Engineered a responsive frontend and scalable backend with Next.js and Node.js.
detailedDescription: As a founding member of MMMUTRESO, I was part of a dedicated team of four developers responsible for co-building and deploying the university's official student resource platform, mmmut.xyz. The goal was to provide a centralized hub for academic resources and foster a stronger student community.
keyResponsibilities: Collaborated with a team of developers to design and implement the full-stack architecture.
Developed the responsive frontend using Next.js and Shadcn/UI.
Engineered the backend with Node.js and MongoDB to manage and serve academic resources.
Integrated caching modules to optimize response times and improve user experience.
Managed and organized over 500+ academic resources, including notes, past year questions, and syllabi.
Scaled the application infrastructure to handle high traffic and concurrent users, especially during exam periods.
achievements: Successfully deployed the platform, serving over 1,000+ active students.
Improved accessibility and reduced bounce rate by 40% by integrating caching modules.
Scaled infrastructure to handle 2,000+ concurrent live users with 99.9% uptime during peak times.
Increased student engagement by 60% through community-building features like placement and event modules.
challenges: Managing large volumes of user data and academic resources efficiently.
Scaling the platform to handle sudden spikes in traffic during exam periods.
Ensuring the reliability and uptime of the platform with limited resources.
learnings: Full-stack development with Next.js and the MERN stack.
Strategies for managing and organizing large-scale data.
Performance optimization and caching techniques.
Deployment and infrastructure scaling for high-traffic applications.
Community-building and user engagement strategies in a digital platform.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Architected a comprehensive medical e-commerce platform for multiple stakeholders.

Implementing secure authentication and role-based access control.
